description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing projects within the Coocook application. It includes actions for viewing, editing, creating, importing, exporting, archiving, unarchiving, renaming, and deleting projects, as well as handling URL routing and permission checks.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Project
classes.description: Controller class for project-related actions in the Coocook application.

methods.name: fallback_old_url_scheme
methods.description: Handles deprecated URL scheme fallback by redirecting to the correct project URL based on URL name or ID.

methods.name: id_only
methods.description: Shortcut for accessing a project by ID without additional URL segments, with permission checks.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures project ID and URL name, loads the project, and sets up project-specific URLs and permissions.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for project views.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays project schedule and permissions, with capability checks.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a project, including project plan and recipes, and outputs JSON for frontend.

methods.name: get_project_plan_ajax
methods.description: Returns project plan data in JSON format for AJAX requests.

methods.name: move_meal_or_dish_ajax
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to move meals or dishes within a project plan.

methods.name: settings
methods.description: Displays project settings page with URLs for update, rename, visibility, and delete actions.

methods.name: exportable_projects
methods.description: Returns a list of projects that can be exported from the current project.

methods.name: get_import
methods.description: Prepares data for importing projects, including available properties and target projects.

methods.name: post_import
methods.description: Handles importing data from another project, with validation and success/error messaging.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project with provided name and visibility, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates project description.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives the project.

methods.name: unarchive
methods.description: Unarchives the project.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames the project.

methods.name: visibility
methods.description: Changes project visibility (public/private).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the project after confirmation.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the project show page.
